en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What you're seeing now is live footage of
the sky from our camera at the scene!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can clearly see the meteors
raining down!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>We are witnessing what looks like
the end of the world!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>This is not a movie! I repeat, this is NOT
a movie! This is live, unedited footage!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>This is real! The sky is falling before
our very eyes!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>We've just been notified that the government
has officially declared a state of emergency!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Subway stations have been opened as shelters!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The government is instructing citizens to remain
calm and evacuate to their nearest shelter!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Children and invalids are to be given
first priori—
<CLT=cltMIND>It was the day after the second class trial.

<CLT=cltMIND>We all headed to Maki's lab on the
3rd floor of the school building.

<CLT=cltMIND>And awaiting us there...
was an unexpected sight.
Wh-What the heck is this?
It's like...weapon warehouse.

See, I told you she's not the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
She's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki...is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltMIND>?

Kokichi...you learned that from the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

Monokuma said everyone's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>
at the beginning of their <CLT=cltSTRONG>video<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Ryoma knew Maki's true identity because he had
her <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
And, because you saw that—

Hm? I knew the whole time. Given my position,
I'd obviously know before any of you, right?
Your "position"?
Oh...don't worry about it. That was a lie.

Anyway, her reaction yesterday pretty much
gave away that she's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Y-Yeah...you can probably...snap my 
neck like a twig right now...

But that's...not your style...
Y-You would rather...kill from the shadows...
Right...Miss <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

But whyever did she lie about being 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Cuz assassins hide to do all their killing!

If people find out they're assassins, they
get all cautious and they can't kill anyone!

Did she hide her real identity because...
she was planning to kill us?

But then, why hasn't she killed anyone yet?
She has had many opportunities to do so.

Geez, robots can't even understand human
feelings, let alone a girl's heart.

Please take back what you just said.
I can too understand human feelings.

But I'm still in the process of collecting data.
Please, give me data! Please!

If you're so worried, why don't you ask her?
She's been holed up in her room all day.

But I can't promise that she won't try to
kill you like she tried to do to me.

Nee-heehee... Good thing everyone was there
to stop her, but what about next time?
Best let sleeping gods lie.

The talent of a killer... That is the biggest
threat to all of us who wish to survive.

Let's just lock her up somewhere so she
can't kill anyone.
I'll leave that to you, Gonta...
Huh? B-But...

I'll help, too! I don't want another killing
to happen.

Ah, wait, you don't have to take it that far...
It's not like she's trying to kill us—

A <CLT=cltSTRONG>sneak attack<CLT=cltNORMAL> is the way to go! We have to
strike before she does! Hit her from behind!

Sneak attack...? Strike before she does?
Should an Aikido master be saying those things?

If that's the case, then Atua and I will work
with everyone to uphold the peace.

If so, then I'll cheer you on. I'll use my magic
to pull pom poms out of my mouth.

Wooow! That kinda peppy cheer magic
would make anyone excited!

Hold on guys. Leave Maki to me...
I'll take down that mask of hers.

Tch, <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL> my ass...
Always messing around...

K-Kaito?
Don't do anything stupid—
O-kay! Let's leave everything to Kaito!

Gonta, you should stand back. Nothing good
ever happens when you try to help.
Hm? Oh yeah...sorry.

Hey, Gonta. Like I told you, a man 
shouldn't apologize so eas—

Oh! I don't need everyone's usual reactions!
Time's a bit of a factor here!
M-Monokuma!?
Everyone! Get behind Gonta!

Himiko, get behind me! I'll surround you
with my body to keep you safe!
I just said I don't need your usual reactions!

It's almost halftime, so the stats should be
out soon for everyone to obsess over...

And since you guys overcame the class trial,
I figured I'd give you all a wonderful <CLT=cltSTRONG>prize<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

I said, I figured I'd give you all a wonderful
<CLT=cltSTRONG>prize<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

...Huh? My adorable little cubs aren't coming?
That's strange.
RISE-AND-SHINE, URSINE!

They're finally here! Yay! You're so cute
today, it's practically obscene!

Just...wow. You guys are seriously cute.
H-Have you always been this cute?

Ahhhh! The shock of my super-cute kids...
seems to be making me...go bald...
...Like, in patches.
He's actually balding!?
Ugh! Gross!
Ahhhh... I-I'm cold... V-Very cold...

Hey, my cute little cubs... Could you hurry
up and give them the <CLT=cltSTRONG>prize<CLT=cltNORMAL>...?

I-It's too cold...I can't s-stand it... Hurry...
I wanna go somewhere warm...

Huh? What's wrong? Why aren't you backing
me up?
FATHER...WE-ARE-NOT-YOUR-SLAVES.
WE-WILL-NOT-LET-YOU-USE-US-ANYMORE.
...Huh?

FROM-NOW-ON...I-WILL-BE-CALLING-THE-
SHOTS.

...Hah! Good one, kids. Very funny. You can
show me where the hidden cameras are now.

F-Father...you're too old for this! You've been
doing this so long, you've become predictable!

It's the age of the Monokubs now!
Out with the old, in with the new!

Wh-What!? But what about all the long-time
fans who—

Anyway, you're just a has-been! Why don'tcha
just retire somewhere and work on your tan!?
H-Has-been!?

GOOD-JOB, YOU-TWO... YOU-MEMORIZED-
MY-SCRIPT-PERFECTLY.

D-Do you really think you can defy your dad!?
Do you think I'd forgive such—
...YOU-WERE-SAYING?
EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEK!!!

DID-YOU-FORGET, FATHER?
ONLY-WE-CAN-PILOT-THE-EXISALS.
...What!? Really!?
How could you forget that!?

THANK-YOU, FATHER, BUT-THE-ACADEMY-IS-
UNDER-OUR-HARMONIOUS-CONTROL-NOW.
...STEP-ASIDE, FATHER.

N-No way! Are you saying that treating you
kids like my property was...wrong!?
It's completely and utterly wrong!
N-No...no...no—
No no no no no wayyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy!!!
Nyeh...he's bald again.

It seems the shock made him bald...
This time...for good.

NOW-THEN, AS-THE-NEW-HEADMASTERS,
WE-HAVE-FOR-YOU-BASTARDS...
A-WONDERFUL-PRIZE!

U-Um... Let's see what the prize is this
time...

We're giving away a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Golden Hammer<CLT=cltNORMAL>, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Magic
Key<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ninja Scroll<CLT=cltNORMAL> as a prize bundle!

Wow...what a buncha random junk.
I-I mean, bravo, bravo!

WE-LOOK-FORWARD-TO-WORKING-WITH-YOU.
I-HOPE-WE-CAN-ALL...GET-ALONG.
I had a feeling it was more junk...

Aw maaan... We didn't need more junk. We had
way too much anyway. And its name is Keebo.

Now you've gone too far! Everyone, we can't
allow this kind of intolerant language!

NO-FIGHTING.
EVERYONE-HAS-TO-GET-ALONG.

USE-THIS-PRIZE-TO-EXPLORE-THE-NEW-
AREAS-TOGETHER.

Also, we've hidden another <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>
somewhere, too.

I hope you all grow even closer now that
you've regained more of your memories.

Geez, those cubs suck.
Monokuma was waaay better.

Damn it... I've got too much pride as a human
to let those robots push me around!

The world would be a better place if robots
didn't exist! They should all be destroyed!

I've recorded your intolerant remarks, and
will report them to the proper authorities.

So what are we going to do? If we use this junk,
we can open up new places, but...

Yayyy! A new area means we can all have
lots more fun.
I don't know if we'll have that much fun...

I find myself more interested in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback
Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Perhaps we'll recall the school's secret.

If that's the case, then we'll deal with
murder girl later.

Hey, bro. I'll leave this to you again.
Do a good job, alright?
O-Okay... Got it.

If you find dangerous place, come get Gonta.
Gonta will protect you.

Nyeeeh...all that aside, what are we 
gonna do with that thing?
Umm...let's just leave him here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I suppose I should go try out these
items around the school like last time.

I'll leave this to you again.
Do a good job, alright?
Ah, well, I don't mind, but...
Hm? You don't mind, but...what?

No, it's just that...when we were talking about
Maki, you looked...really upset.

Well, yeah...
I can't believe she's an <CLT=cltSTRONG>assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I can't believe it either... She doesn't seem
like she could be some terrifying assassin...
Hah! Terrifying, huh?

Either way, leave Maki to me.
I'll take down that mask of hers.

Either way, leave Maki to me.
I'll take down that mask of hers.
<CLT=cltMIND>...I'm not going to bother.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are three black cases lined up.
Do they all have weapons inside?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a lot of different
weapons here...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki knows how to handle all of these...?
Whoa...

<CLT=cltMIND>I exclaimed in awe at the sheer number of
guns lined up. They can't be real...

<CLT=cltMIND>No...of course they aren't real.
They're airsoft guns.

Ah, of course...
Monokuma wouldn't give us *real* weapons.

<CLT=cltMIND>Exisals may be strong, but if we were
to revolt with real guns...
<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma would never allow that.

<CLT=cltMIND>If these weapons were real...
And if Kirumi were here...

<CLT=cltMIND>She might have taken us all out in
order to escape.
<CLT=cltMIND>For her people...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a lot of different
weapons here...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki knows how to handle all of these...?
